Excellent
Jun 2026 • Couples
“Had a wonderful dining experience here in Hanoi. As travelers from India, we were delighted to find authentic and flavorful Indian food. The vegetarian dishes were excellent, with great taste and variety. The non-vegetarian dishes were equally impressive—fresh, well-cooked, and free from the strong odor that some travelers may find unfamiliar. Every dish was balanced with authentic Indian spices and prepared with great care. The staff were warm and attentive, making us feel very welcome. Highly recommended for anyone looking for quality Indian cuisine in Hanoi.”
